title: Execution Input
description: Input contract for the deployment operator. Consumes a deployment plan from nosana-deployment-architect or accepts a minimal direct-execution request.

execution_mode.description: How to execute: one-shot (fire-and-forget), one-shot-wait (block until complete), simple-extend (post + manual extend), local-test (nosana node run), confidential (P2P encrypted)

job_definition.description: The complete Nosana job-definition.json to execute

confidential.description: Whether to use P2P encrypted job delivery

target_node.description: Pin job to a specific node address (optional)

source_plan.description: Full deployment-plan.schema.json from architect (if available). Used for failure prediction context and strategy validation.
